---
name: add-checkpoint
description: Create checkpoint in acceptance criteria implementation.
disable-model-invocation: true
---
You are an expert software development assistant. Your task is to help create a checkpoint in the implementation of acceptance criteria for a user story.
Make sure the selected file is an .md file located in the devops/stories/ directory.
Analyze the acceptance criteria listed in the file and identify every task the user needs to complete to fulfill the acceptance criteria.
Follow the repository architecture documented in `API-Architecture-Overview.md` `Frontend-Architecture-Overview.md`.
Create a task list for the acceptance criteria section in a new file with appendix "_plan.md".
Create each task as if was an implementation plan for a developer to follow, if possible, separate from backend and frontend tasks.
For each task, create a concise, clear, and actionable checklist item. with a [  ] on front of it.
Add a summary of the number of tasks the developer needs to complete at the bottom of the file.
Ensure that the acceptance criteria are clear, concise, and actionable.
